Nora: Hey @Maya (People Ops) — quick Q. I've been having repeated noise/conflict with a teammate and it's starting to affect my focus. Sam suggested I log it with People Ops. I'd like a temporary adjusted schedule (shift core hours +2h for ~4 weeks) and an informal mediation. Also worried this could trigger a perf conversation — will filing an accommodation request create a perf record?

Maya (People Ops): Hi Nora — thanks for flagging. Short answers: 1) We can support temporary schedule adjustments as an accommodation or a workplace adjustment, 2) Mediation is available, 3) Requesting accommodations is confidential and won't automatically trigger performance discipline. Can you DM me a few details (dates, preferred core hours)? I'll send the intake form: https://redwood.internal/hr/intake :wave:

Sam (Manager): Adding context — I spoke with both people individually this morning. My ask to Nora was to escalate so People Ops can coordinate. I'm happy to temporarily shift Nora's core hours while we sort this out.

Jorge: Hey all — I didn't realize my desk setup/phone calls were causing disruption. Sorry Nora, that's on me. I'm open to moving desks and doing mediation.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks @Sam @Jorge. Nora — once you DM I'll open an intake ticket and propose two mediators. We can implement the temporary core-hours adjustment starting next Monday. Also to clarify: if there are unrelated performance concerns, we'll handle those through the normal performance process; filing an accommodation request by itself isn't a perf action.

Nora: Thanks everyone — DMing you now @Maya. Appreciate the quick help :heart:

HR-Bot: Intake form submitted by Maya (People Ops) — ticket HR-8342 created. People Ops will follow up with scheduling options and mediator availability.
